articles.title: Trump Uses Rare 'Pocket Rescission' to Claw Back $1 Billion
articles.summary: President Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion in spending Congress approved, targeting refugee services and diversity programs. A Republican senator calls it illegal. The fight is over who controls the federal purse.

articles.title: Hurricane Nolo's Slow Crawl Could Bring 2 Feet of Rain to Hawaii
articles.summary: Hurricane Nolo is creeping toward Hawaii at just 5 mph, with winds that could reach 140 mph. Forecasters warn of catastrophic flooding and mudslides. The Big Island is under a hurricane watch.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV Draws 700,000 to Paris Mass, Praises Youth as 'Today's Church'
articles.summary: An estimated 700,000 people gathered at Place de la Concorde for an open-air Mass with Pope Leo XIV. He rode down the Champs-Élysées in his popemobile and told young people they are "today's Church."
